name: Koroshi no Dress 2
source:
Hero is a detective who receives a strange request to fake marry a beautiful client woman. But during the wedding she gets killed by someone. Hero starts to investigate her circle of friends and acquaintances.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名侦探，接到一项奇怪委托：与美丽的女性委托人假结婚。然而，婚礼进行期间，她却遭人杀害。主人公随即开始调查她的朋友圈与社会关系。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
